title: Wave 3 Revision — Places, Reporting & Civic Participation
revisionReason: Reframe Civic Map from a ratings-first destination into one consumer of a shared Makati place registry, while preserving completed asset research, reporting infrastructure, emergency handling, duplicate detection, lifecycle semantics and general participation workflows.
productDoctrine: The verified asset inventory is shared civic-place infrastructure, not a set of objects people are expected to rate.
Civic Map is one interface over the place registry, not the owner of the data.
Public-realm participation should start from a user job: report something, check a place, suggest an improvement or help document Makati.
Generic star-style ratings are retired as a primary interaction; structured observations replace them where useful.
Location and nearby-place matching should reduce the need for users to search for an asset before reporting.
Completed source reconciliation for facilities, parks and transport remains authoritative provenance and is not reopened by this redesign.
Existing case lifecycle semantics remain valid and should be reused.
Metrics and QA are deferred until redesigned workflows stabilize.
preservedCompletedWork: General feedback submission, fallback and public tracking
Civic case duplicate detection and public tracking
explicitlyNotReopened: Transport inventory, ferry, jeepney-route and PNR/NSCR research

workstreams.title: Revise Wave 3 backlog
workstreams.maximumScope: Planning/backlog files only. Freeze the old ratings-first direction, preserve completed work, pause superseded tasks, and establish the bounded redesign sequence.

workstreams.title: Disposition current Wave 3 capabilities
workstreams.maximumScope: Create one audit classifying each existing Wave 3 capability as KEEP, REFRAME, REPLACE, DEFER or RETIRE. No code or UX changes.

workstreams.title: Define shared Place Registry schema
workstreams.maximumScope: Schema/design record only. Define canonical place fields and Civic-Map-specific fields. No code migration.

workstreams.title: Introduce Place Registry data layer
workstreams.maximumScope: Data-layer refactor only. Preserve all current place IDs and page behavior; Civic Map may temporarily re-export the same records.

workstreams.title: Add Place Registry selectors
workstreams.maximumScope: Shared helpers only: by barangay, category, service, coordinates/distance and lifecycle. No visible UI changes.

workstreams.title: Reuse places in BetterBarangay
workstreams.maximumScope: Barangay Profile only. Surface verified local places/facilities from the registry.

workstreams.title: Reuse places in Mobility
workstreams.maximumScope: Mobility page only. Replace duplicated MRT, Busway, ferry and terminal facts where appropriate.

workstreams.title: Reuse places in Services and Government Offices
workstreams.maximumScope: Services and Government Offices only. Connect service guides to relevant verified physical locations.

workstreams.title: Add place results to Saan Ako Lalapit
workstreams.maximumScope: Concern Finder only. Where appropriate, answer both which service and where the user can go.

workstreams.title: Reframe Civic Map entry experience
workstreams.maximumScope: Civic Map landing only. Center Report something, Check a place, Suggest an improvement and Help document Makati. Remove ratings-first positioning.

workstreams.title: Simplify place detail experience
workstreams.maximumScope: CivicAsset page only plus tiny shared UI if essential. Remove generic rating-first language while retaining factual details, reports, improvements and source provenance.

workstreams.title: Specify Report something near me
workstreams.maximumScope: Flow specification only: location, nearby place/street, issue, details/evidence, submit, fallback. No implementation.

workstreams.title: Implement nearby place matching
workstreams.maximumScope: Location-to-nearby-place selection only. Do not modify report submission yet.

workstreams.title: Connect nearby reporting to existing civic submission
workstreams.maximumScope: Reporting flow only. Preserve emergency handling, duplicate detection, barangay context, evidence and tracking. Stop after focused E2E validation.

workstreams.title: Reconnect case lifecycle to redesigned reporting
workstreams.maximumScope: Lifecycle display/relationships only. Preserve reviewed, forwarded, acknowledged, action-reported and community-verified-resolved semantics. No automatic forwarding.

workstreams.title: Define structured observations
workstreams.maximumScope: Observation schema only by place/asset family. No UI.

workstreams.title: Replace generic ratings with observations
workstreams.maximumScope: One reusable observation form. No derived scores.

workstreams.title: Add place condition summaries
workstreams.maximumScope: Display recent structured observations and freshness only. Do not publish composite scores.

workstreams.title: Define civic audit campaigns
workstreams.maximumScope: Campaign schema/workflow only: geography, place set, questions, period and completion. No generalized campaign UI.

workstreams.title: Pilot one civic audit
workstreams.maximumScope: One geography and one audit theme only, such as BetterPoblacion sidewalks or Makati park accessibility.

workstreams.title: Publish one audit output
workstreams.maximumScope: One report/output template from pilot observations. Validate usefulness before expanding campaign machinery.

workstreams.title: Revise Participation Hub
workstreams.maximumScope: Participate page only. Align entry points to official participation, local problem reporting, place improvements, documentation, corrections/sources, BetterMakati ideas and volunteering.

workstreams.title: Revise Get Involved
workstreams.maximumScope: Get Involved only. Preserve general submissions and add civic-audit volunteering/handoffs where appropriate.

workstreams.title: Revise BetterBarangay participation
workstreams.maximumScope: Barangay participation integration only: local places, issues, improvements, civic audits and barangay contact.

workstreams.title: Add places to global Search
workstreams.maximumScope: Global Search only. Places become first-class searchable results.

workstreams.title: Reuse places in Visit Makati and Heritage
workstreams.maximumScope: Visit and Heritage only. Reuse canonical place facts without duplicating coordinates/addresses.

workstreams.title: Connect places to Projects and Accountability
workstreams.maximumScope: Relationship model plus a small verified example set only. No mass fuzzy matching.

workstreams.title: Connect City Monitor items to places
workstreams.maximumScope: One-way explicit relationships only for clearly named places. No automated fuzzy matching.

workstreams.title: Add reusable Near me utility
workstreams.maximumScope: One shared nearby-place component/helper after registry reuse is proven elsewhere.

workstreams.title: Redefine participation outcome metrics
workstreams.maximumScope: Metric definitions only: routing, review, acknowledgement, action, resolution, observation freshness, audit coverage and repeat contribution. No instrumentation.

workstreams.title: Define metric publication thresholds
workstreams.maximumScope: Separate internal operational metrics from public metrics and set minimum sample/time thresholds. No dashboards.

workstreams.title: Instrument redesigned participation outcomes
workstreams.maximumScope: API/data instrumentation only for fields defined in W3R-10a/10b. No headline aggregates.

workstreams.title: Run human page audit on redesigned participation
workstreams.maximumScope: Participation, Get Involved, Civic Map/place pages and reports only.

workstreams.title: Add Place Registry integrity audit
workstreams.maximumScope: Guard duplicate IDs, barangays, coordinates, lifecycle states, provenance and broken relationships. No browser testing.

workstreams.title: Test general participation journeys
workstreams.maximumScope: General submission, duplicate, fallback, tracking and barangay-context E2E only.

workstreams.title: Test public-place participation journeys
workstreams.maximumScope: Nearby reporting, place matching, duplicate case, lifecycle, observation and pilot audit E2E only.

workstreams.title: Run mobile and accessibility pass
workstreams.maximumScope: Redesigned Wave 3 surfaces only. Fix only defects found.

workstreams.title: Reclassify and close Wave 3
workstreams.maximumScope: Supersede the old capability classification with an evidence-based redesigned Wave 3 classification, record deferrals, and close only what is actually complete.

immediateNext.title: Define shared Place Registry schema
immediateNext.maximumScope: Schema/design record only. Define canonical place fields, lifecycle/provenance relationships and which fields remain participation-specific. No code migration.
